additional_info.subject: DC/SiD/MP/SG-[MP/N8 160355435] : Suspect PLC corruption after FW upgrade to V6.1.3
additional_info.body:
Dear Helpdesk,
Sicharge D
MP/N8 160355435
Customer: Kim Hock
Country: Singapore
Background: According to case ID0422527, the charger was recently updated to V6.1.3 on last Wed 7 May.
Issue: Charger after shut down for their factory site maintenance, is unable to revive after turned on. The charger screen is stuck at the attached image.
Do kindly note that the technician is trained to safely shut down and turn on charger for their own maintenance purpose.
SCB is able to load some logs but suspect PLC is corrupted.
There is no visible fuse blown on the charger (see attached image).
The charger is not responding to soft/Hard Reboot trigger via SCB
The charger is also offline on the OCPP backend (Depotfinity).
Please provide more support on how to troubleshoot the charger as this is not an expected behaviour for a normal charger shutdown and turn on.
Thank you
Edna
